verdict.rationale: The published front pages show an entry path that needs no account: a quick search by company name or EUID (an identifier-based entry), plus normal and advanced search of all state registers. The supplementary notes describe register search and announcements as public. However, the filing side a founder would actually start, submitting a publication order through the Publikations-Plattform, is mentioned without any evidence that it can begin keyless or by file number. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that no login is required, an account-free or file-number entry for the submission/filing flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
